records.question: Ember is half as old as Nate who is 14.  When she is 14 herself, how old will Nate be?
records.response:
Nate is 14 years old.
Ember is half as old as Nate, so Ember is 14/2 = 7 years old.
Ember will be 14 years old in 14 - 7 = 7 years.
In 7 years, Nate will be 14 + 7 = 21 years old.

records.question: James works for 240 minutes. He takes a water break every 20 minutes and a sitting break every 120 minutes. How many more water breaks does he take than sitting breaks?
records.response:
James takes 240/20 = 12 water breaks.
James takes 240/120 = 2 sitting breaks.
James takes 12 - 2 = 10 more water breaks than sitting breaks.
